FN-HGPXP83-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 591
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/13/2026
House Bill 591 as introduced would appropriate up to $203,404,327 in federal funds to the
Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) for the Rural Health
Transformation Program for specific initiatives for the Fiscal Year 2026.
In addition, this bill would: (1) provide that all funds not expended in Fiscal Year 2026 shall not
revert but shall be carried forward for the purposes appropriated; and (2) allow the Director of
ADECA to seek approval from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services for the
reallocation of these funds, if approved by the majority of the Director of Finance, the Chair of
the House Ways and Means General Fund Committee, and the Chair of the Senate Finance and
Taxation General Fund Committee.

FN-HGPXP83-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 591
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/03/2026
House Bill 591 as passed the House of Representatives would appropriate up to $203,404,327
in federal funds to the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs (ADECA) for
the Rural Health Transformation Program for specific initiatives for the Fiscal Year 2026.
In addition, this bill would: (1) provide that all funds not expended in Fiscal Year 2026 shall not
revert but shall be carried forward for the purposes appropriated; and (2) allow the Director of
ADECA to seek approval from the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services for the
reallocation of these funds, if approved by the majority of the Director of Finance, the Chair of
the House Ways and Means General Fund Committee, and the Chair of the Senate Finance and
Taxation General Fund Committee.
Finally, this bill would create the 14-member Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Rural
Health Transformation Program Funds to: (1) request and receive reports and other data and
information from ADECA or any other administering entity related to the implementation of the
programs funded pursuant to the provisions of this bill; and (2) conduct hearings related to the
implementation of the program. This could increase the obligations of the State General Fund by
an estimated $352 per member for each committee hearing attended in person when the
Legislature is not in session.
